name: OLED Midnight Pure Dark & Battery-Optimized Architecture
designThesis: High-efficiency pure dark theme engineered for true-black OLED displays (#000000). Maximizes power efficiency, reduces nocturnal visual fatigue, and provides crisp WCAG AAA contrast through hierarchical surface elevation tokens and vibrant status accents.
bestFitContexts: Night-time reading and streaming media platforms
Critical infrastructure monitoring and NOC dashboards
Aviation cockpit and maritime navigation consoles

colorStrategy.canvasTone: True pitch black (#000000) for canvas; elevated dark grays (#121212, #18181B, #27272A) for surfaces
colorStrategy.accentUsage: Vibrant Neon Emerald (#10B981), Electric Sky (#0EA5E9), and Solar Amber (#F59E0B) for instant visual feedback
colorStrategy.contrastTarget: Minimum 7.0:1 AAA contrast for primary and secondary text

typographyStrategy.fontPairing: Geist Sans, SF Pro, or Inter paired with JetBrains Mono for code
typographyStrategy.hierarchyEmphasis: High-legibility typography with slightly lighter font weights (400 regular, 500 medium) to prevent text blooming on pure black

layoutRhythm.gridStructure: Clean responsive grid with subtle 1px border separation

surfaceTreatment.borderStyle: 1px hairline border (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)) providing explicit container edges
surfaceTreatment.depthElevation: Luminance-based elevation: higher z-index surfaces receive lighter background fills rather than dark drop shadows

componentGuidelines.primaryActionStyle: Vibrant solid accent button with true-black text (#000000) ensuring 12:1+ contrast
componentGuidelines.cardStructure: Elevated charcoal surfaces (#121212) with distinct 1px border boundaries
componentGuidelines.tablePresentation: Zebra-striped dark rows with high-visibility cell focus outlines

accessibilityProfile.keyboardHandling: Bright white or neon focus indicator with 2px offset
accessibilityProfile.reducedMotionRules: Disable glow animations and smooth transitions on reduced-motion preference

antiPatterns: Pure white (#FFFFFF) high-weight text causing nocturnal halation and visual glare
Dark drop shadows on pure black backgrounds (which are completely invisible)
Colored saturated backgrounds that eliminate OLED power savings

browserChecks: Verify text contrast against elevated surface hierarchy
Verify high-contrast focus rings on pure black
